run_gen_install_table: run the script to generate an HTML install table for detectron2 pip wheels
run_gen_install_table_with_version: run the script with --d2-version flag to generate a versioned install table
gen_header: generate an HTML table header row with torch version column headers

summarize_template: summarize the HTML template used for formatting detectron2 pip install commands
